scope: A40 public host-predicate change only: preserve eligibility semantics while checking mutable tensor metadata in one native call. No GPU pipeline or arithmetic change.

acceptance.directed: Existing rounded-equation gates and qualified pointwise cancellation/underflow checks; actual rounded forward O in delta.
acceptance.saved_statistics: Literal unscaled score maximum and shifted log2 normalizer, independent checks atol2e-4/rtol1e-6.
acceptance.precision: P and dS round once to input dtype; FP32 dots/delta/gradient accumulation; late dQ/dK scaling.

guard_parity.scope: Shape/dtype/layout/device/alignment/scale/options, live storage-offset mutation, deterministic/compiler/runtime flags; CPU and non-tensor rejection. Single-GPU device; alternate-current-device branch runs only when another device exists.

memcheck.scope: One actual selected S4096 F+B per family; S1024 changed/poisoned graphs. Unchanged CPU per-head FP64/rounded/statistics gates.

racecheck.scope: One actual selected S4096 F+B per family; S1024 changed/poisoned graphs. Unchanged CPU per-head FP64/rounded/statistics gates.

synccheck.scope: One actual selected S4096 F+B per family; S1024 changed/poisoned graphs. Unchanged CPU per-head FP64/rounded/statistics gates.

initcheck.scope: One actual selected S4096 F+B per family; S1024 changed/poisoned graphs. Unchanged CPU per-head FP64/rounded/statistics gates.

public-code-D64-S1024.scope: Exact selected graph symbol in actually loaded ELF. CuTe compiler SHA required unless a mapped native CUDA extension is supplied; mapped library symbol and SHA retained otherwise. Separate from latency measurements.

public-code-D64-S4096.scope: Exact selected graph symbol in actually loaded ELF. CuTe compiler SHA required unless a mapped native CUDA extension is supplied; mapped library symbol and SHA retained otherwise. Separate from latency measurements.

public-code-D128-S4096.scope: Exact selected graph symbol in actually loaded ELF. CuTe compiler SHA required unless a mapped native CUDA extension is supplied; mapped library symbol and SHA retained otherwise. Separate from latency measurements.

interpretation: Complete eager short causal calls measure the host change. Graph differences and mixed long-case variation do not establish a GPU-pipeline gain.
Before/native share the same native runner and GPU schedule; before retains the qualified Python predicate.
Paired same-process results should be compared within this run; absolute eager latencies across earlier captures are not an isolated change measurement.
cProfile and scoped NVTX reversed public/direct rankings and are not release timing evidence. Actual uninstrumented intervention supported the host-predicate hypothesis.
fa2_binding_reference: a40-causal-head-groups.json retains exact FA2 loaded-extension/ELF/PTX identities.

controlled_intervention.scope: Benchmark-only bypass after preflight on fixed supported inputs; never a production guard removal. Same-input same-runner full attention, separate graph/eager windows.

profile_limitations.interpretation: Instrumented cProfile and scoped NVTX changed public/direct ordering; they do not causally allocate complete-call overhead or establish a GIL/thread mechanism.

nsight_launch_accounting.thread_scope: Autograd engine can launch backward from a different CPU thread; Python caller NVTX GPU projection alone does not count the complete F+B.
